scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the effective masses from the agent's reported JSON using a comparison to the paper-reported gold values with tolerances; the effective mass values are directly checkable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference effective masses for CeFe4As12, CeFe4P12, CeFe4Sb12 from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and discussion: reported effective masses m*/m0 – CeFe4As12: 1.336, CeFe4P12: 0.166, CeFe4Sb12: 8.992.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper text: 'the calculated value was quite large i.e. m*=1.336m0' and '0.166m0 and 8.992m0 for CeFe4P12 and CeFe4Sb12'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published values, used as ground truth for reproduction.

outputs.description: Computed density-of-states effective masses (in units of m0) for CeFe4As12, CeFe4P12, and CeFe4Sb12 based on the single-parabolic-band model with acoustic phonon scattering.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the effective masses from the same input Seebeck coefficients and carrier concentrations using the SPB model and compare to the agent's reported values. The scoring uses tolerances appropriate for numerical integration and root-finding differences.
